blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Target-speaker and multi-speaker extraction are techniques for extracting speech from a desired speaker or desired speakers in the presence of other speakers and/or noise. Neural network approaches for this task are often trained and evaluated using simulated datasets, with balanced amounts of target speech and speaker enrolment samples which closely match the target speech. However, in real multi-party conversations, participants are often silent for more time than they are speaking, and their enrolment speech samples can differ substantially from the target speech in the conversation. These factors can impact the training and evaluation of these techniques on recordings of real conversations. This work proposes a new loss function, which helps mitigate the effect of excess silence in training, improving STOI from 0.55 to 0.60, and frequency-weighted segmental SNR from 4.35 to 5.12. Additionally, the impact of the mismatch between the enrolment speech and target speech is explored.
blocks.zh: 目标发言者和多语种发言者是在其他发言者和(或)噪音面前从希望发言的人或希望发言的人那里提取发言的技术。 用于这项任务的神经网络方法往往利用模拟数据集进行培训和评价,并配有与目标语音密切匹配的均衡数量的目标语音和演讲者入学样本。 然而,在真正的多党对话中,参与者往往在比他们说话的时间更长的时间内保持沉默,他们的入学演讲样本可能与对话中的目标演讲有很大不同. 这些因素可能影响这些技巧对真实对话录音的培训和评价。 这项工作提出了一个新的损失功能,它有助于减轻训练中过度沉默的影响,使STOI从0.55提高到0.60,频率加权分段SNR从4.35提高到5.12。 此外,还探讨了入学演讲与目标演讲不匹配的影响。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: While existing AHD , such as HA , can improve the listening experience of hearing-impaired listeners in many scenarios, their benefit is often reduced in complex acoustic environments, such as cafes and restaurants. In particular, those with hearing impairments can find it hard to socialise in multi-party conversations in these challenging environments.
blocks.zh: 虽然现有的AHD,如HA,在许多情景中可以改善听力障碍的听众的听觉体验,但是在复杂的音响环境中,如咖啡馆和餐馆,他们的受益往往减少. 特别是,那些听力有缺陷的人在这些充满挑战的环境中很难在多党对话中社交.

blocks.en: The tasks of TSX ( TSX ) have MSX ( MSX ) have been developed to tackle exactly this scenario with NN ( NN )-based techniques [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . However, these techniques often operate under assumptions which are rarely valid in the context of AHD processing. This work highlights and addresses some of these concerns.
blocks.zh: TSX(TSX)的任务已经制定,以便用基于NN(NN)的技术[1、2、3]来准确处理这一设想。 然而,这些技术往往在极少在AHD处理中有效的假设下运作。 这项工作突出强调并解决了其中一些关切问题。

blocks.en: While TSX techniques have successfully been applied to low-latency HA processing [ 1 ] , they only focus on a single speaker, while conversations may include a number of speakers; while this technique could be applied iteratively (once per target speaker), this is inefficient, especially in the context of low-latency processing.
blocks.zh: 虽然TSX技术已成功应用于低纬度HA处理[1],但是它们只侧重于单个扬声器,而对话中可能包括一些扬声器;虽然这种技术可以迭代应用(每个目标扬声器一次),但效率低下,特别是在低纬度处理的情况下.

blocks.en: This motivates the task of MSX , where models extract more than one conversation partner at any given time [ 3 , 4 ] . While this is more aligned with the multi-party conversation scenario, existing techniques do not consider the strict latency requirements of AHD systems; those listening to audio through a HA find delays of > 20 >20 ms disturbing [ 5 ] , so any NN designed for AHD must satisfy this constraint.
blocks.zh: 这激发了MSX的任务,即模型在任何特定时间抽取一个以上的对话伙伴[3,4]. 虽然这更符合多党对话的情景,但现有技术并不考虑AHD系统的严格延迟要求;那些通过HA听音频的人发现延迟 > 20>20 ms扰动[5],因此任何为AHD设计的NN必须满足这一制约.

blocks.en: Additionally, MSX techniques are often explored using simulated datasets, with controlled speaker activity and overlaps [ 6 , 7 ] . In multi-party conversations, speaker activity is very varied, with challenging distributions of utterance lengths and overlaps [ 8 ] ; for example, in a four-party conversation, an interlocutor could be silent for as much as 70 % 70\% of the conversation, creating an imbalance between speech and silence which can impact the training of NN models [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 此外,经常利用模拟数据集探索MSX技术,有受控扬声器活动和重叠[6,7]. 在多党对话中,演讲者的活动非常多样,对言论长度和重叠的分布具有挑战性[8];例如,在四党对话中,一位对话者可以默默地进行多达70%的谈话,造成言论和沉默之间的不平衡,这可能影响NN模式的培训[9].

blocks.en: A further mismatch occurs with the target speaker information; TSX / MSX techniques typically use enrolment speech to identify the target speaker(s) e.g. by computing speaker embeddings [ 1 , 4 ] . With simulated data, this enrolment speech closely matches the target speech in the noisy mixture. In real conversations, the enrolment speech may be read speech, which has different acoustic properties to the spontaneous speech in conversations [ 10 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 与目标扬声器信息发生进一步不匹配; TSX / MSX技术通常使用招生演说来识别目标扬声器,例如通过计算扬声器嵌入[1,4]. 有了模拟数据,这个招生演讲与吵闹的混合物中的目标演讲非常吻合. 在真实的对话中,入学演讲可以被读作语音,这与对话中自发的演讲具有不同的声学属性[10,11].

blocks.en: This work uses the CHiME-9 ECHI dataset [ 12 ] , which captures real four-party conversations in a simulated noisy environment, to investigate the effect of training TSX / MSX models in a realistic scenario. With this, a new loss function is proposed to mitigate the effect of the imbalance in speaker activity by randomly applying VAD ( VAD )-masking to the loss function, controlling the amount of silence that the model is exposed to, leading to improvements in objective speech intelligibility and speech quality metrics.
blocks.zh: 本作使用CHiME-9 ECHI数据集[12],在模拟的吵闹环境中捕捉真实的四方对话,在现实情景中调查训练TSX/MSX模型的效果. 有了这个功能,提议了一个新的损失函数,通过随机将VAD(VAD)-伪装到损失函数上,控制模型所接触的沉默量,从而缓解语音活动不平衡的影响,从而导致客观语音不通和语音质量的衡量标准得到改善.

blocks.en: Further, it is observed that system performance degrades when there is a greater mismatch between the speaker embedding of the enrolment sample and the speaker embedding obtained from the target speaker in conversation.
blocks.zh: 此外,据观察,如果将录用样本嵌入的发言者与对话中从目标发言者那里嵌入的发言者更不匹配,系统性能就会退化。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: This section first describes the data used for this work in Section 2.1 , followed by an introduction to the signal model for the TSX and MSX tasks in Section 2.2 . Then, a technical description of the NN structure is given in Section 2.3 , followed by a mathematical description of the newly proposed loss function in Section 2.4 .
blocks.zh: 本节首先介绍第2.1节中这项工作所使用的数据,然后介绍第2.2节中TSX和MSX任务的信号模型。 然后,第2.3节对NN结构作了技术说明,然后对第2.4节中新提出的损失功能作了数学说明。

blocks.en: 2.1 Data
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据

blocks.en: This work uses the ECHI dataset [ 12 ] , which comprises recordings of real four-party conversations in a simulated noisy environment. In the recording sessions, one person (out of four conversation partners) was wearing two 2 2 -channel HA shells (one on each ear), and another person was wearing Project Aria smart glasses [ 13 ] , which record 7 7 -channel audio. A schematic of the recording setup is given in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 这部作品使用ECHI数据集[12],其中包括模拟吵闹环境中真实的四方对话录音. 在录制环节中,一人(在四个对话伙伴中)身着两枚2 2-声道HA弹壳(每只耳朵各一枚),另一人身着阿里亚项目智能眼镜[13],记录了7 7-声道音频. 图1列出了录音设置图。

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : The approximate layout of the ECHI recording scenario (not drawn to scale). This example layout shows the blue participant in position 1 1 wearing the HA and the orange participant in position 3 3 wearing the Aria glasses.
blocks.zh: 图1:ECHI录制情景的大致布局(不按规模绘制). 这个实例布局显示,11号位置的蓝色参与者穿着HA,3号位置的橙色参与者佩戴Aria眼镜.

blocks.en: Each participant additionally wore a CT ( CT ) microphone to capture speech close to the mouth of the wearer. Reference signals provided in the dataset for the HA and Aria glasses were constructed by denoising the CT microphones [ 14 ] and applying a delay to account for sound propagation [ 12 ] . Also included in the dataset are clean recordings of each participant reading the first paragraph from the rainbow passage [ 15 ] , which can be used as enrolment speech samples of the target speakers to help extract them from the noisy mixture.
blocks.zh: 每位参与者还戴上了CT(CT)麦克风,以捕捉佩戴者靠近嘴边的语音. 用于HA和Aria眼镜的数据集中提供的参考信号是通过点名CT麦克风[14]和延迟计算声音传播[12]来构建的。 数据集中还包括每个参与者阅读彩虹段落第一段的清真录音[15],这些录音可以用作目标发言者的入学演讲样本,以帮助从吵闹的混合物中提取.

blocks.en: The dataset provides 48 48 conversation recording sessions, each with a duration of ∼ 36 \sim 36 minutes; these are split into train ( 30 30 sessions), development ( 10 10 sessions) and evaluation ( 8 8 sessions). Participants in each set are disjoint, so speakers in the train set only appear in the train set, and similarly for development and evaluation.

blocks.en: 2.3 Network Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.3 网络结构

blocks.en: In keeping with typical TSX / MSX systems [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , the model comprises two main components: a speaker encoder network, which produces speaker embeddings of the target speaker(s), and a speech enhancement network, which produces the audio of the target speaker(s). Specifically, this model uses a speech extraction TF-GridNet model, as this has been effective for TSX with low-latency processing [ 1 , 2 ] . The architecture diagram is shown for ℳ MSX \mathcal{M}_{\text{MSX}} in Figure 2 ; for ℳ TSX \mathcal{M}_{\text{TSX}} , one enrolment recording, 𝐫 i \mathbf{r}_{i} , is be provided, and a single channel of audio 𝐭 ^ i \mathbf{\hat{t}}_{i} produced.
blocks.zh: 根据典型的TSX / MSX系统[1,2,3],该模型由两个主要部分组成:一个演讲者编码器网络(生成目标演讲者嵌入的演讲者)和一个语音增强网络(生成目标演讲者的音频). 具体来说,这个模型采用了语音提取TF-GridNet模型,因为这对低纬度处理的TSX是有效的[1,2]. 该架构图在图2中显示为 M MSX\mathcal{M}_{\text{MSX}};在 M TSX\m}_{\text{TSX}},提供1个录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录制录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录录

blocks.en: 2.3.1 Input Features
blocks.zh: 2.3.1 输入特性

blocks.en: First, 𝐗 \mathbf{X} is downsampled to 16 16 kHz before the complex spectrogram is computed. A real-valued representation of the complex spectrogram is obtained by concatenating the real and imaginary components along the channel dimension. For the jointly-trained speaker encoder, the spectrogram of 𝐑 \mathbf{R} is computed in the same way, but the pre-trained speaker encoder operates on the raw waveform [ 16 ] . For the TSX case, the single-channel spectrogram of 𝐫 i \mathbf{r}_{i} is concatenated in a new dimension.
blocks.zh: 首先,X \ mathbf{X}在计算复杂光谱之前,被降低到16 kHz。 通过沿通道维度对真实的和想象的组件进行调整,获得复杂光谱的实值表示. 对于联合训练的扬声器编码器,R\ mathbf{R}的谱系是用同样的方式计算出来的,但预先训练过的扬声器编码器在原始波形上运行[16]. 对于 TSX 案例, r i \ mathbf{r}_{i} 的单通道光谱图在一个新的维度中缩合 。

blocks.en: The STFT ( STFT ) uses a Hanning window, with a window size of 128 128 samples ( 8 8 ms), and the hop size is 64 64 samples ( 4 4 ms).
blocks.zh: STFT(STFT)采用咸宁窗口,窗口尺寸为128 128个样本(8 8 ms),跳跃尺寸为64 64个样本(4 4 ms).

blocks.en: 2.3.2 Speaker Encoder
blocks.zh: 2.3.2 议长编码器

blocks.en: The purpose of the speaker encoder is to produce an embedding of the target speaker, based on some enrolment speech samples; here, the rainbow passage provided in the ECHI dataset [ 12 ] is used. This work considers two approaches: joint training of a speaker embedding model [ 1 , 2 ] , or using a pre-trained model [ 16 , 17 ] . It should be noted that while AHD algorithms are required to be low-latency, the outputs of this speaker embedding model can be cached for inference, meaning they need not be low-latency.
blocks.zh: 演讲者编码器的目的是根据一些招生语音样本制作一个目标演讲者的嵌入;在这里,使用ECHI数据集[12]提供的彩虹通道. 这项工作考虑了两种办法:联合培训一名发言者嵌入模型[1、2],或使用经过预先培训的模型[16、17]。 需要注意的是,虽然AHD算法需要低纬度,但这种扬声器嵌入模型的输出可以缓存推断,这意味着它们不需要低纬度.

blocks.en: For the jointly-trained model, the network architecture follows [ 2 ] . The spectrogram of the enrolment speech is passed through the same convolutional encoder as the noisy audio, before being processed by a sequence of U-Nets [ 18 ] . Finally, a 2 2 D average pooling is applied along the time-dimension to form a speaker embedding 𝐯 ∈ ℝ L \mathbf{v}\in\mathbb{R}^{L} .
blocks.zh: 对于联合训练的模型,网络架构遵循[2]. 招生演讲的谱系通过与喧闹的音频相同的演化编码器传递,再由U-Nets的序列处理[18]. 最后,一个2 D 平均集合在时间分配上应用,以形成一个扬声器嵌入 v QQR L\mathbf{v}\in\mathbb{R}^{L}.

blocks.en: The pre-trained model takes the same clean-speech samples, but processes them through the RawNet3 speaker embedding model [ 16 , 17 ] , to produce a 1 1 D speaker embedding.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的模型取了相同的清音标本,但通过RawNet3扬声器嵌入模型[16,17]进行处理,生成一个11D扬声器嵌入.

blocks.en: For MSX , the embeddings for each of the enrolment speech recordings are computed separately, and concatenated when conditioning the FiLM ( FiLM ) layer [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 对MSX来说,每个注册语音录音的嵌入部分分别计算,并在调节FiLM(FiLM)层[19]时调和.

blocks.en: 2.3.3 Speech Enhancement Network
blocks.zh: 2.3.3 增强言论网络

blocks.en: Fig. 3 : The GridNet architecture with FiLM conditioning.
blocks.zh: 图3:带有FiLM调制的GridNet架构.

blocks.en: The backbone of the speech enhancement system is the TF-GridNet architecture [ 20 , 1 ] , along with a FiLM layer [ 19 ] . First, the multi-channel spectrogram passes through a convolutional encoder to produce the representation 𝐖 0 \mathbf{W}_{0} . The FiLM layer conditions 𝐖 0 \mathbf{W}_{0} on the speaker embedding 𝐯 \mathbf{v} , before a BiLSTM operates along the feature dimension. The output is then reshaped, so the unidirectional LSTM operates over the time dimension, before the input 𝐖 0 \mathbf{W}_{0} and both LSTM outputs are summed and passed to the self-attention block, which outputs 𝐖 1 \mathbf{W}_{1} . This block can be repeated, hence Figure 3 takes 𝐖 j \mathbf{W}_{j} as input and produces 𝐖 j + 1 \mathbf{W}_{j+1} .
blocks.zh: 语音增强系统的骨干是TF-GridNet架构[20,1],还有一个FiLM层[19]. 首先,多通道谱通过一个演化编码器来生成代表W 0\mathbf{W}_{0}. FiLM 层条件 W 0\mathbf{ W}_{0} 在扬声器嵌入 v\mathbf{v} 上,在 BiLSTM 沿着特征维度运行之前. 输出随后被重塑,因此单向的LSTM在时间维度上运行,在此之前输入W 0\mathbf{W}_{0},LSTM输出均被汇总并传递到自注意块,该块输出W 1\mathbf{W}_{1}. 此块可以重复, 因此图 3 以 W j\ mathbf{ W}_{j} 作为输入并生成 W j + 1\ mathbf{ W}_{j+1} 。

blocks.en: This block must be low-latency, so specific choices were made to ensure minimal look-ahead: the time-dimension LSTM is unidirectional, and the self-attention mechanism is masked to avoid any look-ahead to future frames.
blocks.zh: 这个块必须是低纬度的,因此做出了具体的选择,以确保最小的外观前方:时间分配的LSTM是单向的,自我注意机制被蒙蔽以避免任何外观前方到未来帧.

blocks.en: 2.4 Loss Function
blocks.zh: 2.4 函数损失

blocks.en: 3 Training Setup
blocks.zh: 3 培训设置

blocks.en: All training and model hyperparameters were consistent across the model variants, with the exception of the learning rates. The final speech enhancement network had 3.8 3.8 M trainable parameters. The jointly-trained speaker encoder network had 4.3 4.3 M trainable parameters, while the pre-trained RawNet3 speaker embedding model had 28.5 28.5 M frozen parameters. The VAD masks 𝐕 \mathbf{V} are generated using speech timestamps provided in the ECHI dataset [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 除学习率外,所有培训和模型超参数都与模型变体一致。 最终的语音增强网络有3.83.8M可训练参数. 联合训练的扬声器编码器网络有4.3 4.3 M可训练参数,而预先训练的RawNet3扬声器嵌入模型有28.5 28.5 M的冷冻参数. VAD 口罩 V\ mathbf{V} 使用 ECHI 数据集提供的语音时间戳生成 。 [12] 。

blocks.en: Models were trained for 30 30 epochs using the Adam optimiser [ 22 ] . The learning rate was scheduled using a linear warm-up over the first three epochs, before cosine annealing was applied over the remaining 27 27 epochs [ 23 ] , and gradients were clipped to 1 1 . The best learning rate for each model variant was either 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} or 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} .
blocks.zh: 30个世纪的模特儿接受了训练 使用亚当·奥蒂米瑟号[22]. 学习速率在前三个纪元上采用线性暖化,在余下27个27纪元[23]上应用余弦反射法前,将梯度剪切为11. 每个模型变体的最佳学习率要么是1×10−4 1\time 10×4}要么是5×10×5 5\time 10×5}.

blocks.en: A validation loop on the development set was run every two epochs, and the checkpoint used for the final evaluation was the one which produced the highest STOI ( STOI ) [ 24 ] score on the development set. Further details of the exact training configurations can be found in the GitHub repository † † Found at: github.com/MxRobsta/ECHI-SpeechEnhancement .
Using a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, training typically took ∼ 1.5 \sim 1.5 days and enhancement for the 4.8 4.8 hours of audio in the evaluation set took ∼ 45 \sim 45 minutes.
blocks.zh: 使用单一的NVIDIA H100 GPU,训练一般需要 \\ 1.5\sim 1.5天,在评价集中增强4.84.8小时的音频需要 \ 45\sim 45分钟.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: To evaluate the performance of the system, a range of speech metrics is used. These metrics are only computed on speech segments of the audio.
blocks.zh: 为了评价系统的性能,使用了一系列语音衡量标准. 这些衡量标准只在音频的语音部分计算。

blocks.en: To assess speech intelligibility, STOI [ 24 ] is computed. The speech quality metrics used are PESQ ( PESQ ) [ 25 ] and the composite measures [ 26 ] , which compute Csig (signal quality), Cbak (background intrusion), and Covl (overall quality for communication). Finally, fwSegSNR ( fwSegSNR ) [ 27 ] is computed as a signal level metric; this metric is derived from SNR with a weighting applied to the frequency bands to more closely reflect human hearing.
blocks.zh: 为了评估语音不通晓性,STOI [24]是计算出来的. 使用的语音质量衡量标准是PESQ(PESQ)[25]和综合衡量标准[26],计算Csig(信号质量)、Cbak(背景入侵)和Covl(通信的总体质量)。 最后,fwSegSNR(fwSegSNR)[27]是作为信号级度量衡计算出来的;这一度量是从SNR中推导出来的,其加权适用于频段,以更紧密地反映人类听觉.

blocks.en: The results are presented in Table 1 and are computed for the 6525 6525 target speech segments for the ECHI HA recordings. Similar trends are observed on the ECHI Aria glasses recordings; these results are available online at the link above.
blocks.zh: 调查结果见表1,并按ECHI HA录音的6525 6525个目标演讲部分计算。 ECHI Aria眼镜录音也有类似趋势;这些结果可在上述链接上查阅。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Results on the evaluation split of the ECHI dataset. The Pre-Spk column indicates whether the speaker embedding is pre-trained (✓) or jointly trained (blank).
blocks.zh: 表1:关于ECHI数据集的评价结果。 " Spk预选栏 " 表示发言者的嵌入是经过预先训练的还是经过联合训练的。

blocks.en: For ℳ TSX \mathcal{M}_{\text{TSX}} , training with ℒ Spec \mathcal{L}_{\text{Spec}} was found to annihilate the signal, producing silence. This is due to the high proportion of silence in the reference signal, so this model was only trained with ℒ VAD ( 80 ) \mathcal{L}^{(80)}_{\text{VAD}} . This effect was avoided for ℳ MSX \mathcal{M}_{\text{MSX}} as there was typically speech present in at least one channel, meaning the overall target was rarely just silence.
blocks.zh: 对于 M TSX \ mathcal{ MQQText{ TSQ} , 使用 Spec\ mathcal{ LQQText{ Spec} 的训练被发现可以消灭信号, 产生沉默 。 这是因为参考信号中的沉默比例很高,所以这个模型只接受了L VAD(80)\mathcal{L}^{(80)}\VAD{VAD}的训练. 对于 M MSX \ mathcal{ MQQText{ MSX}}} 这个效果被避免了,因为至少在一个频道里通常会出现语音,这意味着总体目标很少只是沉默.

blocks.en: The first point to note is that across all the metrics, the best TSX model performs similarly to the best MSX model trained with ℒ Spec \mathcal{L}_{\text{Spec}} from ( 6 ). This is interesting, as the MSX model is provided with more information about the overall scene; it receives speaker information about all of the target speakers, which should make the task easier.
blocks.zh: 第一点需要注意的是,在所有的度量衡中,最好的TSX模型的性能与训练有L Spec\mathcal{L}_{\Text{Spec}的MSX模型相似(6). 这很有趣,因为MSX模型得到了更多关于整个场景的信息;它得到了关于所有目标发言者的演讲者信息,这可以使任务更容易完成.

blocks.en: However, it is clear that training the MSX models with ℒ VAD ( 80 ) \mathcal{L}_{\text{VAD}}^{(80)} improves the performance across all of the metrics ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ). Further, training with the pre-trained speaker embeddings shows a slight improvement over all metrics except STOI ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 except for STOI , p > 0.1 p>0.1 ); significance is determined by Wilcoxon test. This suggests that high proportions of silence in the reference audio can limit performance, but randomly applying the VAD -mask can compensate for this and improve performance.
blocks.zh: 然而,显然,使用L VAD(80)\mathcal{L}_{\\text{VAD{(80)}培训MSX模型可以提高所有衡量标准的业绩(p < 0.01 p<0.01)。 此外,使用预先训练过的扬声器嵌入的培训显示,除STOI(p < 0.01 p < 0.01,STOI除外,p > 0.1 p > 0.1)之外,所有度量标准都略有改进;意义由Wilcoxon测试确定。 这表明参考音频中高比例的沉默可以限制性能,但随机应用VAD -mask可以弥补这一点并改进性能.

blocks.en: Further details on tuning the proportion of silence presented to the model are discussed in Section 4.1 , and the influence of the pre-trained speaker embeddings is considered in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 第4.1节讨论了将沉默比例调整到模型的进一步细节,第4.2节讨论了预先训练过的扬声器嵌入的影响。

blocks.en: 4.1 VAD-Masked Loss Function
blocks.zh: 4.1 VAD- Masked 损失函数

blocks.en: The argument behind defining the randomly VAD -masked loss in ( 9 ) is that the amount of silence that the model trains with can be controlled. For this to be meaningful, the threshold used to mix the masked loss with the raw loss must be carefully considered. To assess this, Table 2 shows the same metrics as in Table 1 , computed with different degrees of VAD -masking in ( 9 ). Note that the models presented here are ℳ MSX \mathcal{M}_{\text{MSX}} with pre-trained speaker embeddings, and the scores for 0 % 0\% masking are equivalent to training with ℒ Spec \mathcal{L}_{\text{Spec}} from ( 6 ), and 100 % 100\% is equivalent to training only with ℒ VAD \mathcal{L}_{\text{VAD}} from ( 8 ).
blocks.zh: 定义随机VAD - 假冒损失在(9)中背后的理由是,模型列车的沉默量可以控制. 为了使这一点有意义,必须认真考虑用于将蒙面损失与原始损失混为一谈的门槛。 为了评估这一点,表2显示了与表1相同的衡量标准,按不同程度的VAD(9)计算。 请注意,这里介绍的模型是M MSX\mathcal{M}_{\text{MSX}},带有预先训练的扬声器嵌入,而0%0\%口罩的分数相当于L Spec\mathcal{L}_{\text{Spec}}从(6)开始的训练,100%100\%只相当于LVAD\mathcal{L}_{\text{VAD}}从(8)开始的训练.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Scores for different levels of usage of ℒ VAD \mathcal{L}_{\text{VAD}} . * indicates scores which appeared in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 表2 : LVAD\mathcal{L}_{\Q}_{\Text{VAD}的不同使用水平的分数* 表示表1中出现的分数.

blocks.en: The results in Table 2 show that training with too much silence in the reference signals degrades the MSX model’s performance on objective metrics. For all metrics, the worst scores occur with either 0 % 0\% or 20 % 20\% VAD -masking, and the best scores with 80 % 80\% or 100 % 100\% VAD -masking.
blocks.zh: 表2的结果表明,在参考信号中过于沉默的培训会降低MSX模型在客观衡量标准上的性能。 在所有度量衡中,最差的分数为0 % 0 % 或 20 % 20 % VAD - makeing,最佳分数为80% 80 % 或 100% 100 % VAD - makeing.

blocks.en: There are small performance increases for the 100 % 100\% model over the 80 % 80\% model in the perceptual metrics. This can be expected to a certain extent; these metrics are only computed on speech segments, so training only on speech segments is likely to produce better results here. However, as described previously, it is also important that the model can process scenarios where one or more of the target speakers are not speaking. This suggests that while training on exclusively using ℒ VAD \mathcal{L}_{\text{VAD}} may yield slight improvements for these objective metrics, for the overall use-case, 80 % 80\% would provide a better experience.
blocks.zh: 100%的100QQ模型比80%的80QQ模型在知觉度量中有小的性能提升. 这在某种程度上是可以预期的;这些衡量标准只在演讲部分进行计算,因此,只有演讲部分的培训才可能在这方面产生更好的结果。 然而,如前所述,模型还可以处理一个或一个以上目标发言者不发言的情况。 这表明,虽然关于完全使用L VAD \ mathcal{L}_{\Q}_{\text{VAD}}}的培训可能会使这些目标衡量标准略有改进,但对于总体使用情况来说,80%的80\%将会提供更好的经验。

blocks.en: 4.2 Speaker Similarity
blocks.zh: 4.2 议长的相似性

blocks.en: The speaker embeddings are used to help guide the TSX and MSX systems towards the target speakers. These embeddings are generated using clean, read speech samples of the target speakers, but it is known that there are acoustic differences between read speech and the spontaneous speech that can be found in the conversations [ 10 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 发言者的嵌入有助于引导TSX和MSX系统面向目标发言者. 这些嵌入物是使用目标发言者的清洁,读取的语音样本生成的,但已知读取的语音和自发的语音之间有声学差异,可以在对话中找到[10,11].

blocks.en: To assess the impact of this mismatch, RawNet3 embeddings [ 16 ] are computed from two speech sources. The enrolment embedding is generated using the enrolment speech, 𝐫 i \mathbf{r}_{i} from the ECHI dataset [ 12 ] , as is used during training. A reference embedding is computed by taking the mean of five embeddings computed from the reference signal, 𝐭 i \mathbf{t}_{i} ; these were generated by randomly selecting five speech segments with a duration of more than 3 3 seconds. The difference between embeddings is computed with cosine similarity.
blocks.zh: 为了评估这种不匹配的影响,RawNet3嵌入[16]是从两个语音来源计算出来的. 入学嵌入是使用入学演说(r i \ mathbf{r}_{i})从ECHI数据集[12]生成的,用于训练. 引用嵌入是通过从参考信号t i \ mathbf{t}_{i} 中计算出5个嵌入的平均值计算的;这些嵌入是通过随机选择5个语音段产生的,持续时间超过3 3秒。 嵌入体的区别用余弦相似性计算.

blocks.en: To expand the number of data points, speakers in both the development and evaluation sets are considered, giving n = 54 n=54 speakers. By computing Pearson- r r correlations, it can be seen that PESQ shows a medium correlation with the cosine similarity ( r = 0.49 r=0.49 , p < 0.01 p<0.01 ), and all other metrics show a strong correlation ( r > 0.5 r>0.5 , p < 0.01 p<0.01 ).
blocks.zh: 为扩大数据点数,考虑开发和评价组中的发言者,给予n=54n=54的发言者。 通过计算Pearson-r r 相关性,可以看出PESQ显示与余弦相似性(r = 0.49 r = 0.49,p < 0.01 p < 0.01)的中度相关性,所有其他度量标准都显示强烈的关联性(r > 0.5 r > 0.5,p < 0.01 p < 0.01).

blocks.en: This suggests that the mismatch in target speaker information is causing a drop in performance. Some speakers are poorly matched from their enrolment speech to the target speech, and in these cases, the objective performance is worse.
blocks.zh: 这表明目标发言人信息不匹配导致性能下降. 有些演讲者从报名演讲到目标演讲的配比差,在这种情况下,客观表现更差.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: The real-time enhancement of conversations provides slightly different challenges when compared to more traditional TSX and MSX tasks. This work shows that using a VAD -masked loss function leads to significant improvements in both perceptual and signal-based metrics, suggesting that models trained with this methodology will perform better. It can also be seen that using pre-trained speaker embeddings can provide some marginal benefit for these metrics.
blocks.zh: 与较传统的TSX和MSX任务相比,对话的实时增强提供了略微不同的挑战. 这项工作表明,使用VAD-假冒损失函数可大大改进以视觉和信号为基础的衡量标准,表明通过这种方法培训的模型将发挥更好的作用。 也可以看到,使用事先训练过的扬声器嵌入可以给这些度量衡提供一些边际的好处.

blocks.en: Future work could consider using a speaker adaptivity mechanism to update speaker embeddings during a conversation, meaning that the speakers can be more easily recognised by their spontaneous speech instead of their read speech.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可以考虑使用发言者适应性机制,更新发言者在对话中嵌入的内容,这意味着发言者更容易通过自发发言而不是阅读发言得到认可。
